title: Numerical characteristics, functions and sums of random variables

steps.title: Expectation and variance
steps.idea: The mean is the centre of mass of the distribution; the variance is the mean squared spread around it.
formula: M ξ = Σ xᵢ pᵢ  or  ∫ x f(x) dx

steps.title: The 3σ rule
steps.idea: For a normal variable almost all values lie within three standard deviations of the mean.

steps.title: Sums and convolution
steps.idea: The density of a sum of independent variables is the convolution of their densities.
